instruction: Look at task-017_initial.scad. Build an interlocking calibration tile with an overall envelope of 88 x 88 x 12 mm, using +Z as the top direction. Make the 88 x 88 mm tile body span z=0 to z=8 mm. On the body's +Z (top) face, add four vertical registration pegs of 10 mm diameter centered at (-26,-26),(-26,26),(26,-26),(26,26); each peg must start at z=8 mm and be 4 mm high. Cut four 8 mm diameter circular pockets centered at (-26,0),(26,0),(0,-26),(0,26) through the full body thickness along Z. Cut two horizontal rounded-end edge relief slots, each 44 x 5 mm with its long axis parallel to X, centered at (0,39) and (0,-39); both slots must pass through the full body thickness along Z. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-017_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output.
